import os, json, zipfile, re, glob

base = os.environ.get('WORKSPACE', os.getcwd())

    idxs = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(re.escape(s), text)]

    json.dump(report, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

print(json.dumps({'subject_amounts': found, 'any_subject_level_amount': any_subject_amount}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

import os, json, zipfile, re, glob

base = os.environ.get('WORKSPACE', os.getcwd())
